sonnet.problem: Mephibosheth and Absalom were already shown as answers on card 4 (as wrong answers) and are used again here, Mephibosheth as the right answer. Mephibosheth is also named on cards 1, 5 and 6 as the master Ziba talks about, so the right answer is handed over before the question.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: Saul is named on card 1 (King Saul's grandson) and card 9 (the family of Saul's house). Absalom is named on card 1 and was already used as an answer on cards 4 and 7. Both right answers are given away by earlier cards and reuse earlier answers.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
